firstScreen.notes: DOM: h1 contains only 'PORCHES' with full title in .sr-only; trade+city+outcome not visible in headline. Kicker carries trade+city but is visually subordinate. Phone visible, two distinct CTAs, next band peeks via min-height.

distinctiveness.notes: DOM: floor-band + baluster-rule signature in hero, floor-1, floor-2, floor-3, footer (5 sections). Elevation badge fixed SVG. Unique thesis executed. Palette and type pair differ from siblings.

type.notes: DOM: Bebas Neue display, Source Sans 3 body, DM Mono accent. Fluid clamp scale. Tabular numerals on counters. Display tracking -0.03em. Middle-dot meta strings in lead and proof are AI-slop tells (-0.5). No en-dash or curly quotes (-0.5).

layout.notes: DOM: Clear single-job sections. Tone alternation dark/paper/paper/break/deep/paper/accent/dark/paper/dark. Split-layout, split-reverse, grid, statement, full-bleed break families. Asymmetric floor-2. Gap between sections exceeds gap within.

photo.notes: DOM: All images have descriptive alt text, width/height attributes, loading=lazy on non-hero, fetchpriority=high on hero. Consistent filter treatment. Placeholder mode prevents verifying on-topic frames; 8.0 is expected placeholder ceiling.

copy.notes: DOM: Voice matches concept sentences verbatim. Specific trade nouns throughout. Sample tags on all reviews and prices. Consistent 'Price it' CTA. Honest demo thank-you. No banned phrases. Buttons named for action.

mobile.notes: DOM: Mobile bar with call+price CTAs hidden at >=900px. All interactive elements min 48px. CSS breakpoints restructure grids. Elevation badge hidden under 640px. Cannot verify phone-specific crops without screenshots (-0.5).

a11y.notes: DOM: Skip link, sr-only h1, labels on all inputs, tabs with proper ARIA roles, aria-live on checklist and ZIP results, focus styles 3px outline offset 3px, reduced-motion CSS shows all content, forced colors borders, no heading skips.

motion.notes: DOM: Clip-path hero wipe, char-rise type-mask, baluster rule draw, elevation badge highlighting, stagger reveals, tab transitions. Reduced motion fully respected. Lenis loaded. Consistent hover language. At least 3 hooks beyond plain reveals.

wow.notes: DOM: Porch safety checklist is trade-specific with actionable output and CTA handoff. Elevation badge is signature moment tied to thesis. Tool output is text-only which limits score (-0.5 from potential 9), but CTA adds interactivity.

polish.notes: DOM: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon, OG 1200x630, theme-color, JSON-LD GeneralContractor, print stylesheet, lazy images with dimensions, hero preload, forced colors handled. Footer credits have empty <a> tags with no href (-0.5).

mustFix.problem: Visible h1 is only 'PORCHES'; trade, city and outcome are hidden in .sr-only. Sighted visitors do not see 'Worcester Triple-Decker Porch Rebuilds' as the headline.
mustFix.fix: Make the full title visible as the h1 (e.g., 'WORCESTER PORCH REBUILDS') while preserving the type-mask signature effect. Move 'PORCHES' to a decorative element or remove the sr-only duplication.

elevate.move: Restructure the hero so the h1 visibly carries 'Worcester Porch Rebuilds' while preserving the type-mask signature, making the trade and city part of the signature moment rather than relegating them to a kicker.

Enhance the safety checklist tool output from plain text to a designed result card using the floor-band visual language with a mini elevation icon showing the relevant floor lit, connecting tool output to the thesis.
